title: mri_entowm_seg
description: Segment white matter near gyrus ambiens entorhinal cortex using a deep learning model.

input_image.description: T1-weighted image(s) to segment. Can be a path to a single image or a directory of images.
input_image.title: Input Image

output_segmentation.description: Segmentation output file or directory (required if --i is provided).
output_segmentation.title: Output Segmentation

recon_subjects.description: Process a series of FreeSurfer recon-all subjects, enables subject-mode.
recon_subjects.title: Recon Subjects

subjects_directory.description: Set the subjects directory, overrides the SUBJECTS_DIR env variable.
subjects_directory.title: Subjects Directory

conform.description: Resample input to 1mm-iso; results will be put back in native resolution.
conform.title: Conform Flag

etiv.description: Include eTIV in volume stats (enabled by default in subject-mode and with --tal).
etiv.title: eTIV Flag

tal.description: Alternative talairach xfm transform for estimating TIV, can be file or suffix (for multiple inputs).
tal.title: Talairach Transform

write_volumes.description: Save label volume stats (enabled by default in subject-mode).
write_volumes.title: Write Volumes Flag

exclude_labels.description: List of label IDs to exclude in any output stats files.
exclude_labels.title: Exclude Labels

keep_ac.description: Explicitly keep anterior commissure in the volume/QA files.
keep_ac.title: Keep Anterior Commissure

vox_count_volumes.description: Use discrete voxel count for label volumes.
vox_count_volumes.title: Voxel Count Volumes

color_table.description: Alternative color lookup table to embed in segmentation. Must be minimal, including 0, and sorted.
color_table.title: Color Table

population_stats.description: Alternative population volume stats for QA output.
population_stats.title: Population Stats

vmp.description: Enable printing of vmpeak at the end.
vmp.title: VMP Flag

threads.description: Number of threads to use. Default is 1.
threads.title: Threads

percentile.description: Use intensity percentile threshold for normalization.
percentile.title: Percentile

output_base.description: String to use in output file name; default is sclimbic.
output_base.title: Output Base

no_cite_sclimbic.description: Do not cite sclimbic paper at the end.
no_cite_sclimbic.title: No Cite Sclimbic
